title: Pcf
description: APQC's Process Classification Framework at packages/naive/src/functions/pcf.json (EE-165): one version and edition of the PCF, levels 1 to 5, as APQC publishes it, with the attribution APQC's licence requires. Each element has a hierarchy id (1.0 for a category, 1.1 for a process group, 1.1.1 for a process, then activities and tasks), its name verbatim from APQC and its five-digit element id. Hierarchy ids can change between PCF versions and element ids do not. Element ids are not unique within a version: APQC files a few elements at two hierarchy ids, so nothing here requires them to be. The elements are written by scripts/import-pcf.ts and checked across elements by packages/naive/src/checks/check-pcf.ts.

edition.description: Which PCF this is. Only the cross-industry edition is carried.

published.description: The year and month APQC published this version.

attribution.description: The attribution APQC's licence requires in every copy and derivative work of the PCF, verbatim.

elements.description: Every element of levels 1 to 5, sorted by hierarchy id.

id.description: The hierarchy id. A category's ends in .0 (4.0); below it each part counts from 1 (4.1, 4.1.1).

name.description: The element's name, verbatim from APQC, with no space at either end.

level.description: 1 category, 2 process group, 3 process, 4 activity, 5 task.
